title: Red team exercises tied to UAP subject matter

tellings.quote: exercises um that were global and dealt very closely with other subject matter related to UAP were involved with those

plain: In the 1990s, a former military helicopter pilot named Jake Barber says he took part in global "red team" exercises, mock attacks run to test defenses, that dealt closely with subjects tied to UAP, the government's term for unidentified flying objects. Barber tells this as someone who was involved. If true, it would mean the military was already rehearsing around such objects decades ago.
